description: This is a FastAPI backend module that provides REST API endpoints for user profile management, including creation, retrieval, updating, searching, and deletion of user profiles. It uses SQLAlchemy for database interactions, async functions for asynchronous operations, and includes route definitions with detailed docstrings.

methods.name: create_user_profile( profile_data: UserProfileCreate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None )
methods.description: Creates a new user profile using data from the request body, injecting trusted user ID if not provided, checks for existing profile, and saves to database.

methods.name: get_my_profile(request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's profile based on trusted user info.

methods.name: update_my_profile( profile_update: UserProfileUpdate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None )
methods.description: Updates the current user's profile with provided data, sets the updated timestamp, and commits to database.

methods.name: get_profile_by_id( profile_id: str, request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None )
methods.description: Fetches a user profile by profile ID, with access control based on profile visibility and user ownership.

methods.name: search_profiles( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search query for display name or username"), favorite_sport: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by favorite sport"), location: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by location"), verified_only: bool = Query(False, description="Show only verified profiles"), limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Number of profiles to return"), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of profiles to skip"), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None )
methods.description: Searches for user profiles based on query filters like display name, location, favorite sport, etc., with access limited based on profile visibility.

methods.name: delete_my_profile( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None )
methods.description: Deletes the current user's profile from the database.

methods.name: UserProfileResponse _convert_profile_to_response(profile: UserProfileDB, is_own_profile: bool = False)
methods.description: Utility function to convert database profile object to API response format.
